title: An acyclic faithful coherent Chow twist on an integral proper algebraic space
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and use algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Modules and quasi-coherence are on the small etale ringed sites [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module], with module direct image and tensor pullback [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors]. Locally Noetherian means locally Noetherian on etale scheme charts [pqf-def-locnoeth]; Noetherian means additionally quasi-compact and quasi-separated (quasi-compact diagonal). Coherent means quasi-coherent with coherent pullbacks on all etale scheme charts [pqf-def-coherent]. Let $A$ be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and let $g:Z\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ be proper, with $Z$ nonempty, reduced and irreducible. Proper has the chartwise and topological meaning [def-sfb-space-morphism-properties]; reduced means that etale scheme charts are reduced, and irreducible refers to the atlas point topology [def-a1-space-point-topology]. There exist integers $n,d\geq0$, a scheme $T$, a proper surjective morphism $\pi:T\to Z$ and a closed immersion $j:T\hookrightarrow\mathbf P^n_A$ over $\operatorname{Spec}A$ such that all of the following hold for these data, where $L=j^*\mathcal O_{\mathbf P^n_A}(1)$ is the pulled-back twisting sheaf [def-pc-projective-space-twist] and $G=\pi_*(L^{\otimes d})$, with tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]: (a) $(j,\pi):T\to\mathbf P^n_A\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}Z$ is a closed immersion; (b) $G$ is coherent, its support (the locus of nonzero geometric stalks) is all of $|Z|$, and $\operatorname{Ann}_{\mathcal O_Z}(G)=0$; (c) $g_*G$ is coherent and $R^qg_*G=0$ for every $q>0$. Projective space is [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change], closed immersion is [def-weil-closed-immersion], and surjectivity is on point spaces. The integer $d$ is part of the asserted data: the conclusions are not claimed for every $d$ or every such $(T,\pi,j)$. Here the annihilator is the ideal of local functions killing the module, and higher direct images are the right derived functors in module sheaves computed by injective resolutions [def-sp-injective-resolutions].

source.place: Tag 08AR (lemma-proper-pushforward-coherent), construction for condition (3), from weak Chow to the full-support calculation; projective inputs Tags 089J (lemma-weak-chow) and 08AQ (lemma-kill-by-twisting); coherent.tex Tag 02O4 (lemma-locally-projective-pushforward). This is an existential projective-twist witness, not the universal proper direct-image theorem.

proof.text: Put $B=\operatorname{Spec}A$. Every etale scheme chart $U\to Z$ is locally of finite type over $B$, by the chartwise finite-type hypothesis on $g$. Applying pqf-lem-locnoeth-lft to $U\to B$ shows that $Z$ is locally Noetherian. Properness makes $Z$ quasi-compact, and separatedness makes its diagonal over $B$ a closed immersion. Together with the quasi-compact absolute diagonal of $B$, the diagonal factorization makes $Z$ quasi-separated. Explicitly, after affine scheme tests the relevant diagonal factors are closed immersions and hence affine; their composite is quasi-compact. Thus $Z$ is Noetherian. Apply lem-sfb-space-weak-chow to obtain $n,T,\pi$ and an immersion $j:T\to\mathbf P^n_A$ with $g\pi=qj$, with $\pi$ proper and universally surjective.

source.place: Tag 08AR, condition (3), weak Chow paragraph; Tag 04ZK chart argument written out using the scheme locally-Noetherian theorem.

proof.text: Write $h=g\pi$, which is proper by composition. The projective-space projection $q:\mathbf P^n_A\to B$ is proper, hence separated. Proper cancellation applied to $qj=h$ makes $j$ proper; as $T$ and $\mathbf P^n_A$ are schemes and $j$ is an immersion, lem-weil-pbc-proper-immersion-closed makes $j$ a closed immersion. The weak-Chow and composition nodes use topological quasi-compactness; we check the chart form of the statement, of lem-sfb-space-proper-base-change and of lem-sfb-space-proper-cancellation. Let $W$ be an affine scheme. For $W\to B$, a finite affine cover $T=\bigcup T_i$ of the quasi-compact scheme $T$ gives the finite affine cover $T_i\times_BW$ of the scheme $T\times_BW$, which is thus quasi-compact. For $w:W\to Z$, the space $T\times_ZW$ is the base change of the separated diagonal $\Delta_g:Z\to Z\times_BZ$ along the scheme map $(\pi,w):T\times_BW\to Z\times_BZ$, so it is a closed subscheme of $T\times_BW$ and quasi-compact. The separatedness, finite-type and universal-closedness clauses of the conventions agree. Hence $h$ and $\pi$ are proper in the chart sense, and $\pi$ is proper in the sense of the statement.

source.place: Tag 08AR, paragraph after weak Chow: the immersion is closed.

proof.text: The graph $\gamma:T\to T\times_B Z$ of $\pi$ is the pullback of the closed diagonal $\Delta_g:Z\to Z\times_B Z$. Hence it is a closed immersion: on every scheme test this is base change of a closed immersion. The map $T\times_B Z\to\mathbf P^n_A\times_B Z$ induced by $j$ is also a closed immersion, since its scheme tests are base changes of $j$. Composition, checked on these same scheme tests, gives the closed immersion $k=(j,\pi):T\to\mathbf P^n_Z$ in (a). On each standard projective chart both $j^*\mathcal O(1)$ and $k^*\mathcal O(1)$ have bases whose transition ratio is $x_i/x_l$ pulled back to $T$. Identifying these bases gives $L=j^*\mathcal O(1)\cong k^*\mathcal O(1)$.

source.place: Tag 08AR, graph and twist paragraph (correcting its displayed target); Tag 03KO graph square written out.

proof.text: On a standard trivializing open of $L$ every nonnegative tensor power is free of rank one; hence $L^{\otimes e}$ is quasi-coherent and coherent for all $e\geq0$. Here $T$ is locally Noetherian because $h:T\to B$ is a finite-type scheme morphism. Apply lem-sfb-space-projective-serre-vanishing to $k$ over the Noetherian space $Z$ and to $j$ over $B$, taking $F=\mathcal O_T$, which is coherent by lem-sfb-space-noetherian-coherent-support. If the resulting thresholds are $a,b$, set $d=\max(0,a,b)$. Then $M=L^{\otimes d}$ satisfies $R^q\pi_*M=0=R^qh_*M$ for every $q>0$. Put $G=\pi_*M$.

source.place: Tag 08AR, simultaneous applications of Tag 08AQ to the two embeddings.

proof.text: We prove coherence using projective finiteness, independently of the general proper direct-image theorem. For an affine etale chart $U\to Z$, put $T_U=T\times_ZU$. It is a scheme because $U\to Z$ is representable etale; the base change $k_U$ is a closed immersion $T_U\hookrightarrow\mathbf P^n_U$. The chart $U$ is locally Noetherian. The map $T_U\to U$ is proper as a base change of $\pi$, hence quasi-compact and separated. The restriction $M_U$ is locally free of rank one and therefore quasi-coherent of finite presentation (locally $M_U=\mathcal O$ with the presentation $\mathcal O^{\oplus0}\to\mathcal O\xrightarrow{1}M_U\to0$). Module direct image commutes with this etale restriction. The scheme Zariski/etale equivalence identifies that direct image with the associated Zariski projective pushforward. Lem-pc-m1-projective-pushforward-finite-type-independent gives finite type for the latter. Quasi-coherence follows from the same equivalence's direct-image clause. On the locally Noetherian scheme $U$, pqf-lem-coherent-ft-locnoeth gives coherence. Thus $G$ is quasi-coherent with coherent restrictions to every such chart, which is precisely coherence on $Z$. The same argument with $j$ over the scheme $B$ proves that $h_*M$ is coherent.

source.place: Tag 08AR, projective coherence input; coherent.tex Tag 02O4, lemma-locally-projective-pushforward, degree zero, on etale scheme charts.

proof.text: Apply the relative Leray spectral sequence to $T\xrightarrow{\pi}Z\xrightarrow{g}B$ and $M$. Its $E_2^{p,q}=R^pg_*R^q\pi_*M$ is zero for $q>0$. For $q=0$ every outgoing differential on page $r\geq2$ lands in row $1-r<0$, and every incoming differential starts in row $r-1>0$, so all are zero. Thus $E_\infty^{p,0}=R^pg_*G$. In total degree $m$ the finite abutment filtration has just this potentially nonzero graded piece, so $R^mg_*G\cong R^mh_*M$. The latter is zero when $m>0$ by our choice of $d$. For $m=0$ this gives $g_*G\cong h_*M$, coherent by the preceding projective calculation. This proves (c).

source.place: Tag 08AR, relative Leray paragraph, with the one-row degeneration expanded.

proof.text: The coordinate sections $s_i=j^*x_i$ of $L$ have nonvanishing opens covering $T$, by lem-weil-pbc-projective-ample-invertible. If $d>0$, their tensor powers generate $M$: where $s_i$ is a basis, so is $s_i^{\otimes d}$. For $d=0$, use the section $1$ of $M=\mathcal O_T$. Fix $z\in|Z|$ and a point $t\in T$ above it by surjectivity; choose a geometric point $\bar t$ above $t$ and put $\bar z=\pi\bar t$. Pick a generating global section $s$ of $M$ nonzero at $t$. Regard it as a global section of $G=\pi_*M$. The counit $\epsilon:\pi^*\pi_*M\to M$ sends $\pi^*s$ to $s$: this is the adjunction triangle identity for the section $\mathcal O_T\to M$. By lem-sfb-ringed-topos-pullback-stalk, $(\pi^*G)_{\bar t}=G_{\bar z}\otimes_{\mathcal O_{Z,\bar z}}\mathcal O_{T,\bar t}$. If $G_{\bar z}$ were zero, the image of $\pi^*s$ under the stalk of $\epsilon$ would be zero, whereas $s$ is a basis at $t$. Hence $G_{\bar z}\ne0$. Stalk vanishing for a quasi-coherent module depends only on the underlying point, by lem-sfb-space-etale-chart-support. Thus $\operatorname{Supp}(G)=|Z|$.

source.place: Tag 08AR, final global-generation paragraph, applied at each point instead of only the generic point; definitions of geometric stalk and vanishing of a germ.

proof.text: Finally let $U=\operatorname{Spec}R\to Z$ be an affine etale chart. It is reduced by hypothesis. The coherent pullback $G_U$ has full ordinary support on $U$ by lem-sfb-space-etale-chart-support. Write $N=\Gamma(U,G_U)$, a finite $R$-module. The support-annihilator formula gives $V(\operatorname{Ann}_R N)=\operatorname{Spec}R=V(0)$, so the radical-equality lemma gives $\sqrt{\operatorname{Ann}_R N}=\sqrt0=0$, since $R$ is reduced. Therefore $\operatorname{Ann}_R N=0$. On every principal open of $U$ the same argument applies, so the sheaf annihilator is zero on $U$. These etale charts cover $Z$, whence $\operatorname{Ann}_{\mathcal O_Z}G=0$. All required data are the same $n,d,T,\pi,j$ chosen above; no universal assertion about arbitrary twists was used.

source.place: Tag 08AR, last sentence about scheme-theoretic support, expanded on reduced etale affine charts.

proof_origin.place: Tag 08AR, verification of condition (3), weak Chow construction through final support calculation; graph and adjunction typos corrected, projective coherence on etale charts made explicit.
